vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: deepvista-vistabase-card
Version: 0.1.0-alpha.19

The skill bundle provides a standard interface for managing knowledge cards via the 'deepvista' CLI. It includes commands for CRUD operations, semantic search, and regex-based searching, with explicit instructions in SKILL.md for the AI agent to seek user confirmation before executing any write or destructive operations. No evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or prompt injection was found.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: it is an instruction-only wrapper around the deepvista CLI for managing knowledge cards; the main remaining risks come from the external CLI package and the related 'deepvista-shared' auth skill.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the implementation: the SKILL.md simply instructs the agent to run the deepvista CLI to list/get/create/update/delete/search cards. The only external requirement is the deepvista binary (installed via the deepvista-cli package) and a dependency on deepvista-shared for auth/global flags—this is proportionate to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are narrowly scoped to invoking deepvista CLI commands and presenting the resulting card URL. Write operations are flagged to require user confirmation. The SKILL.md does not instruct the agent to read unrelated files, environment variables, or send data to third-party endpoints beyond the DeepVista app URL.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Install spec uses an 'uv' package named deepvista-cli that creates a deepvista binary. The install entry is plausible for installing a CLI, but the registry/source is unspecified here. That makes the install step the primary trust boundary—verify the deepvista-cli package origin and integrity before installing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: This skill declares no required env vars, which is consistent with the instructions. However, authentication and global flags are delegated to deepvista-shared (not included here); you should inspect deepvista-shared to see what credentials or tokens it requires and how they are stored/used.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true, does not modify other skills' configs, and declares no config paths. Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) but the skill itself has no elevated persistence or system-wide privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill itself is a thin wrapper around the deepvista CLI and appears coherent. Before installing or enabling it: (1) verify the deepvista-cli package source/registry and inspect its repository or release artifacts to ensure you trust the binary that will be installed; (2) review the referenced deepvista-shared SKILL.md to learn what credentials or auth flow it uses and where tokens are stored; (3) confirm that you want the agent to run an external CLI binary (the agent will execute the 'deepvista' program on your system); and (4) when the agent asks to perform write/destructive actions, confirm them manually (the skill instructs to ask, but you should still be cautious). If you cannot validate the CLI package or the shared auth skill, treat the install as higher risk and avoid enabling it.
